+    return p, q, eef
+
+
+def action_rows(q, grip=-1.0, count=1, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0, mode=-1.0):
+    a = np.zeros((count, 13), dtype=float)
+    a[:, :7] = np.asarray(q)
+    a[:, 7] = grip
+    a[:, 8:11] = base
+    a[:, 11] = torso
+    a[:, 12] = mode
+    return a
+
+
+def backproject(obs, camera, u, v, frame=0):
+    """Back-project one RGB-D pixel through that response's OpenGL calibration."""
+    T = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    K = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    depth = float(np.asarray(obs.depth[camera])[frame, int(v), int(u)])
+    if not np.isfinite(depth) or depth <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("pixel has no valid depth")
+    x = (float(u) - K[0, 2]) * depth / K[0, 0]
+    y = -(float(v) - K[1, 2]) * depth / K[1, 1]
+    world = T @ np.array([x, y, -depth, 1.0])
+    return world[:3]
+
+
+def probe_position_jacobian(robot, q, axes=range(6), delta=0.04):
+    """Estimate d(eef xyz)/d(q) from short, safe joint perturbations."""
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float).copy()
+    rows = []
+    segments = []
+
+    def add(target, n):
+        rows.extend(action_rows(target, grip=-1.0, count=n))
+
+    add(q, 8)
+    for j in axes:
+        add(q, 6)
+        qp = q.copy()
+        qp[j] += delta
+        begin = len(rows)
+        add(qp, 10)
+        end = len(rows)
+        add(q, 8)
+        segments.append((j, begin, end))
+
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "joint_position", np.asarray(rows), interpolate="hold", cameras=[], video="none",
+        video_fps=20, note="online proprioceptive finite-difference Jacobian",
+    )
+    P = np.asarray(res.proprio)
+    J = np.zeros((3, 7), dtype=float)
+    for j, begin, end in segments:
+        dq = P[end, 4 + j] - P[begin, 4 + j]
+        if abs(dq) > 1e-4:
+            J[:, j] = (P[end, 26:29] - P[begin, 26:29]) / dq
+    return J, res
+
+
+def position_step(robot, target_xyz, grip=-1.0, max_joint_step=0.12, settle_steps=24):
+    """Take one damped, clipped Cartesian correction using an online Jacobian."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[])
+    _, q, eef = state(obs)
+    J, _ = probe_position_jacobian(robot, q)
+    error = np.asarray(target_xyz, dtype=float) - eef
+    dq = np.linalg.pinv(J[:, :6]) @ error
+    peak = max(float(np.max(np.abs(dq))), 1e-9)
+    if peak > max_joint_step:
+        dq *= max_joint_step / peak
+    q1 = q.copy()
+    q1[:6] += dq[:6]
+    A = np.zeros((settle_steps, 13), dtype=float)
+    A[:, :7] = np.linspace(q, q1, settle_steps)
+    A[:, 7] = grip
+    A[:, 12] = -1.0
+    return robot.submit(
+        "joint_position", A, interpolate="hold",
+        cameras=["robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"],
+        video="none", include_depth=True, note="RGB-D Cartesian correction",
+    )
+
+
+def pinch_lift(robot, q, lift_joint=1, lift_delta=-0.30):
+    """Close, lift, and return the fixed-camera observation for grasp checking."""
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    q1 = q.copy()
+    q1[lift_joint] += lift_delta
+    A = np.concatenate((
+        action_rows(q, grip=1.0, count=14),
+        np.column_stack((
+            np.linspace(q, q1, 28),
+            np.ones((28, 1)),
+            np.zeros((28, 3)),
+            np.zeros((28, 1)),
+            -np.ones((28, 1)),
+        )),
+    ))
+    return robot.submit(
+        "joint_position", A, interpolate="hold",
+        cameras=["robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"],
+        video="none", include_depth=True, note="pinch and verify by fixed RGB-D camera",
+    )
+
+
+def save_observation(obs, name):
+    path = OUT / name
+    obs.save(str(path))
+    return path
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=list(spec["cameras"]), include_depth=True, video="frames")
+    save_observation(obs, "gen_initial")
